verdict.rationale: Logseq has a local HTTP API server with human-readable documentation and a single method-dispatch endpoint, but the evidence states that no OpenAPI document is published. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The plugin API docs are community-driven, human-readable pages, not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
